rule: one fixed body per state (the 3R centre frame); only the head and neck change per frame (owner option A, G3 2026-11-08)
frameIndexMeaning: index = app/ClockGaze.cs ClockAngles index: 0 = 12 o'clock (head up), clockwise in 30 degree steps
hourMeaning: 12 = head up, 3 = viewer's right, 6 = head down, 9 = viewer's left

headMeasures.landmarks: LANDMARKS in Register-ClockV12.py, native px of each image; none recorded yet (see families.<f>.headSizeCheck)
headMeasures.rescaleRule: only when the measured ratio is off by more than 2%: the region above the seam is rescaled by 1/ratio about the neck base
headMeasures.ratio: mean over the available measures of (return measure x placed scale) / (centre measure x centre scale), canvas px

hazeRule: a return with any corner alpha > 8 has every pixel with alpha <= 14 zeroed before alignment (hazeFloored)
resample: uniform LANCZOS on premultiplied alpha (float box); no warp, no repaint

rear.seamWhy: Back view: the head and neck are a column ~200 px wide down to row ~650 (solid width 195-213 px from row 593 to 653); from ~660 the shoulders widen (240 px at 673, 256 at 693) into the ruff/shoulder mass. The seam sits at the top of that mass; the lowest returned chin (h07, head down) is ~620, above the feather top 640. 120 px above the band top 800.
rear.blend: premultiplied RGB and alpha, smoothstep over the feather rows
rear.alignmentWindow: rows 660..799 all columns + rows 800..905 columns >= 470, alpha > 64, IoU

head.why: Not measured to 2 %: the clock turns the head in yaw AND pitch away from the centre pose (only 12/6 are pure pitch and 3/9 pure yaw, and even those start from a centre that is itself turned), so every 2D landmark distance is foreshortened by 10-50 % on most hours (rear h12 ear-apex spacing ~1.6x and h01 ~0.64x the centre's while the ear-base span stays ~1.0x; Codex also re-poses the mobile ears). Silhouette-only landmarks miss ears turned off the outline, the iris size varies with the drawn eyelids (look-back 0.55-1.06x the centre's), and hand-read landmarks on these fluffy heads carry about +/-5 native px, more than the 2 % gate on a 70-270 px measure. No frame was rescaled: the head keeps the body-alignment scale. Check size on clock-<f>-heads.png (centre head outline in red).

lookback.seamWhy: Look-back: the head-down hours (5-7) put the chin and whiskers at ~430-470 and every return redraws the chest ruff with the head, so the ruff (front edge x 940-950 at rows 330-530) must come from the return; a seam inside it leaves a shelf on the chest edge (up to 53 px at row 480, 12 px at 600). The ruff narrows into the straight front leg at ~660 (right edge x 858-860 from row 666 to 746): there the chest/leg edge agrees within 3 px on every hour and the leg stripes run on across the seam; the left back edge sits 10-15 px inside the fixed body's (soft fur; flagged on the hours over 12 px). 40 px above the band top 700.
lookback.blend: premultiplied RGB and alpha, smoothstep over the feather rows
lookback.alignmentWindow: rows 660..699 all columns + rows 700..900 columns >= 436, alpha > 64, IoU

side.seamWhy: Side: head rows 455-600 (chin ~590), the chest ruff in front (right edge x 690-698, rows 593-693) and the back from row ~610 on the left; the front leg begins below ~720. Codex reshapes the chest with the head, so the turned-down hours step inside the fixed chest edge (flagged).
